name: Discovery (STS-51)
about: Discovery (STS-51) (1993-058A), a crewed vehicle (OV-103), launched 1993 Sep 12. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1993 Sep 14), held fixed
GCAT names the site (KSC RW15); its coordinates are written from memory
